• Formulas: Add calculated columns with the formula editor. Formulas can reference other fields, do arithmetic, format dates, and produce conditional buckets.
  • Buckets: Define rule-based bucketing on any column (e.g., bucket Amount into Small/Medium/Large). Buckets show up as a virtual column in groupings and filters.
  • Advanced (JSON): The escape hatch. The full report definition is editable as JSON; use this for things the visual builder doesn't expose yet.
  • Folder & Category: Both are free-text labels for organizing reports — pick conventions that match your team's reporting structure.
